title: Nonlinear signal enhancement of strongly-coupled molecules in pump-probe experiments
summary: Nonlinear spectroscopy is widely used to study the transient dynamics of molecules under strong light-matter coupling, though it remains unclear to what extent uncoupled intracavity molecules obscure signals from the strongly-coupled species of interest. Pump or probe fields resonant in the strongly-coupled spectral region will preferentially interact with cavity-coupled molecules, but can exhibit severe optical artifacts due to wave interference in the cavity.
